stats.band_rule: critical >=60% of a country's unengaged groups with NO resource found · high >=30% · partial >0 · covered 0
stats.caveat: NO RESOURCE means not found in the pools checked — eBible, PNG.Bible, Arclight/JESUS Film, Door43 and Faith Comes By Hearing. GRN audio, api.bible, DBL and progress.bible are unchecked; absence here is never proof that nothing exists.
stats.basis: data/tables/people-group-pins.json — the same index the pins are drawn from, so the fill and the dots cannot disagree.
stats.curated_columns: growing_unreached, deaths_day and growth come from the curated country analysis over a narrower set and are NOT derived from the pins. A row flagged from_pins_only carries null for all three, because this build does not know them — null, never zero, which would be a claim.
